metadata.title: CSA Cyber Trust mark – Supporter tier, AI security requirements (Annex B)
metadata.remarks: Includes only Supporter-tier clauses. Derived from Annex B (printed pp. 30–111) of the CSA Cybersecurity Certification: Cyber Trust mark document (v202504), using the "AI security" column only. Only clauses with a AI-specific statement are included; clauses marked "#" in that column (meaning the Classical cybersecurity statement also applies) are omitted and are covered by the classical catalogs. Statements reproduce the source wording.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The organisation has included AI-specific risks, including: – risk of data leakage arising from both malicious attacks and unintended data disclosure by employees; and – risk of compromise to the integrity of data and/or the AI model, resulting in unintended output from its AI system(s) and has included mechanisms to provide adequate human oversight over the organisation’s AI system(s).

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: In identifying the relevant laws, regulations and/or guidelines, the organisation has factored in the emerging landscape of AI regulations in the countries it operates in.
